HPI3D at CeBIT Lab 2012 (Hall 26, H12)

Our Computer Graphics Systems working group will be present at CeBIT 2012 in Hannover from 6 until 10 Oct. At the joint booth of the Hasso-Plattner-Institut, we will present two projects we are currently working on: “Virtual 3D City Models on Tablets and Smart Phones” and “Visual Analysis of Software Systems”. For example, we will present and demonstrate software system that allows users to explore large virtual 3D city model on a tablet in an interactive manner. This project also has been selected as part of CeBIT guided tours.

You are welcome to visit the CeBIT lab (hall 26, booth H12) to meet us and talk to us.
